issues.description: The problem statement (UML and textual description) specifies acceptSupplyDelivery should take four parameters (supplier name, ingredient name, price, quantity) i.e., acceptSupplyDelivery(String, String, int, int), but the solution implements acceptSupplyDelivery with three parameters (ingredient name, price, quantity) i.e., acceptSupplyDelivery(String, int, int). This parameter mismatch can confuse students about the required signature and cause them to implement a method that does not match the reference/tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the artifacts consistent. Either update the problem statement (UML and textual description) to require acceptSupplyDelivery(String name, int price, int quantity) (ingredient name, price, quantity) or update the solution and any tests to implement acceptSupplyDelivery(String supplierName, String ingredientName, int price, int quantity). Preferably remove the supplierName parameter from the spec if it is unused, or ensure the solution accepts it (and ignores or records it) so the signature matches the documented API.
